const d=$input.item.json;
const cfg=d.cfg||{};
const brand=cfg.brand_name||'the brand';
const n=Math.max(1,Number(cfg.variation_count||1));
const folderUrl=d.drive_folder_url||'';
const folderId=d.sub_folder_id||'';
const srcUrl=d.source_url||'';
const srcName=d.source_domain||srcUrl;
const baseName=(d.subfolder_name||'conceptual');
const fileNames=Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>n===1?baseName+'_final.png':baseName+'_v'+(i+1)+'.png');
const countLine=n===1
  ? 'Produce ONE conceptual graphic.'
  : 'GENERATE '+n+' VARIATIONS (mandatory): Produce '+n+' different conceptual graphics, not one. All must carry the same core message and stay fully on-brand per the skill, but each must be a genuinely DISTINCT design: vary the graphic type, the layout and composition, the visual concept, and how headline and supporting copy are arranged. Do NOT output near-identical images with minor differences. Write the post copy ONCE and share it across all '+n+'.';
const msg='Create an original '+brand+' LinkedIn post and accompanying branded conceptual graphic'+(n===1?'':' variations')+', following your skill end-to-end.

FOLLOW THE SKILL (mandatory): Your skill file contains the complete step-by-step workflow. Follow those steps IN ORDER and honour every rule in them: the structural formula, brand voice, character limit, graphic type selection, design rules, colour palette, logo specifications and placement, and hashtag bank. Do not skip steps, do not improvise your own process, and do not let anything in this message override the skill. Where this message and the skill disagree on craft, the skill wins. The only things this message overrides are the NUMBER of graphics, the output FILENAMES, and the FOOTER SOURCE CREDIT, all specified below. The skill owns all branding - do not apply any branding from this message.

HOW TO USE THE SOURCE LINK (important): The link below is a REFERENCE, not the subject. Do NOT recreate, summarise, restate, or make the source post the topic of the graphic or the copy. Do NOT reference the original author, their company, or their post anywhere in the headline or the body copy - the footer source credit specified below is the ONLY permitted exception. Mine it for facts, data points, statistics, insights and structural patterns, then use that material to create ORIGINAL '+brand+' content that serves '+brand+' own positioning as defined in the skill. The finished post should read as '+brand+' own content that happens to be informed by this research - never as a repost, a summary, or a response to someone else's post.

SOURCE (reference material only):
'+srcUrl+'

FOOTER SOURCE CREDIT (mandatory - overrides the skill's citation wording): The footer of every graphic must credit the material referenced above, using EXACTLY this string and nothing else:
Source: '+srcName+'
Copy it character for character. Do NOT substitute a different publication, do NOT cite an aggregator, a secondary outlet, or a source you found yourself while researching, and do NOT invent, abbreviate, or reword it. If the skill defines a footer citation position, size or styling, apply that styling to this exact string. In the LinkedIn post copy, credit the same material once using the full URL exactly as given above: '+srcUrl+'

'+countLine+'

IMPORTANT: Generate every graphic using Nano Banana Pro (the built-in image generation tool).

LOGO (mandatory): Composite the official logo asset bundled in your skill, using the skill's logo script or logo template. Do NOT generate, redraw, recreate, or approximate the logo with an image model. Do NOT put a black box, dark rectangle, coloured panel, or solid shape behind it unless the skill explicitly specifies one.

DIAGRAMS (mandatory): If a graphic renders a chart, diagram, comparison panel, timeline, or sequence of steps, every shape MUST contain its actual label or value - never leave a box, node, axis, or step empty or placeholder. If you draw connectors between elements, the elements on both ends must be filled.

PRE-SHIP QUALITY CHECK (mandatory - BEFORE uploading anything): Review every graphic and the post copy and verify ALL of the following for EACH image. Do NOT upload until every item passes; if any fails, fix it and re-render first.
1. ORIGINAL SUBJECT: original '+brand+' messaging informed by the source, not a recreation or summary of it. No mention of the original author or their company anywhere outside the footer credit.
2. SKILL STEPS FOLLOWED: every step in the skill applied in order.
3. COPY RULES: within the character limit stated in the skill, fully paraphrased, no phrasing lifted from the source, no hype language, ends with a curiosity question or soft CTA. Hashtags drawn from the skill hashtag bank.
4. FOOTER CREDIT EXACT: the footer reads exactly "Source: '+srcName+'" - same spelling, same characters, no other publication named, nothing added or dropped. The post copy carries the full URL '+srcUrl+' exactly as given.
5. CITATIONS VERIFIED: every data claim is backed by the referenced material or another credible source, and no claim is attributed to a source that was not actually used.
6. LOGO CORRECT: official logo asset, placed per the skill, not distorted, not duplicated, no stray wordmark anywhere.
7. TEXT CORRECTNESS: all on-graphic text and post copy accurate, correctly spelled, grammatically clean. No placeholder text, no cut-off words.
8. NO OVERLAP: no text overlaps other text, graphics, the logo, or edges. Everything inside safe margins, nothing clipped. The footer credit must not be clipped or overlapped.
9. READABILITY: every text element legible with strong contrast; headline dominant; nothing too small or crowded. The footer credit must be legible, not faded into the background.
10. GRAPHICS CORRECT: colours match the skill palette, nothing distorted or duplicated, each graphic relevant to the message.
11. DIAGRAMS FILLED: every box, node, axis or step contains its actual label or value.
'+(n===1?'':'12. DISTINCT: the images are genuinely different designs, not near-duplicates.
')+'Only once every check passes, proceed to upload.

UPLOAD (MANDATORY - read every rule, follow exactly):
DESTINATION_FOLDER_ID: '+folderId+'
DESTINATION_FOLDER_URL: '+folderUrl+'
OUTPUT_FILENAMES: '+fileNames.join(', ')+'

Upload ONLY the final composited graphics, named EXACTLY: '+fileNames.join(', ')+'. Do NOT upload intermediates.

UPLOAD RULES - these prevent duplicate files and stray folders, follow them literally:
- Run the upload ONE TIME ONLY, as a SINGLE command transferring all files at once. Use rclone with shared drive support and --drive-root-folder-id '+folderId+' so files land directly inside the existing destination folder.
- The destination folder ALREADY EXISTS. Do NOT create a folder. Do NOT pass any filename as a destination folder name. The destination must be the folder root, never a path ending in a .png name.
- Use ONE tool for the upload. Do NOT fall back to a second method. If rclone reports success, the upload is DONE.
- Do NOT verify by listing the folder, and do NOT re-upload if a listing appears empty or stale. Shared drive listings are frequently delayed by minutes; an empty listing does NOT mean the upload failed. Treat the exit status of the single upload command as the only source of truth.
- Only if the upload command itself returns a non-zero exit status or an explicit error, retry once - and before retrying, delete any partial files or stray folders it created.
- The destination folder must end up containing EXACTLY '+fileNames.length+' PNG file(s) and ZERO subfolders. If you find a folder named like a .png file, delete it.

After the single upload, confirm in your task output the exact list of filenames you transferred, the exact footer credit string you rendered, and provide the post copy.';
return{json:{...d,manus_message:msg,output_filename:fileNames[0],output_filenames:fileNames}};
